dialog.title: Delete your account?
dialog.lead: This cannot be undone once the grace period ends.

consequences.disabled: Access is disabled immediately — you are signed out everywhere, and any ongoing game session ends in an error.
consequences.purge: Data is permanently deleted after {{days}} days, or shortly after.
consequences.cancel: You can cancel the deletion before that date by signing in again with a Discord code.

dialog.error: Could not schedule the deletion. Please try again.

inventory.sessions: Game sessions and your full play history
inventory.reports: Reports you sent to the administrator

status.purgeNote: The deletion job runs once a day, so it may happen up to a day later.

scheduled.title: Your account will be deleted
scheduled.lead: Access has been disabled. You have been signed out on every device.
scheduled.cancelBody: Sign in again with a Discord code before that date and the deletion is cancelled. There is no cancel button here because you are no longer signed in.

pending.title: Your account will be deleted
pending.lead: The app stays unavailable until you cancel the deletion.

caveats.lost: Sessions that were errored out when you requested deletion, and unregistered devices, do not come back.
caveats.permanent: Once the data is permanently deleted it cannot be recovered.

pending.notScheduled: This account is not scheduled for deletion.
pending.cancelFailed: Could not cancel the deletion. Please try again.
